headline: Agents need feedback, not more instructions.
lede: Skills for teams that run coding agents on their GitHub issues. They read what the loop already records, report what happened, and propose the smallest change that fixes it.

problem.title: A loop that needs you for every item isn't a loop.
paragraphs: Coding agents claim issues, open pull requests and review each other's work. When a day goes well, nobody looks. When it doesn't, the cost hides in retried runs, sent-back PRs and items waiting for a person.
The evidence is already on GitHub: claims, outcomes, denied commands, retrospectives. Reading it by hand takes longer than the runs did, so it rarely happens.
These skills read it for you. They name the cause, count what it cost, and propose a fix that removes text or scope instead of adding another rule.

changes: Added uberblick-intake 0.1 in the new Uberblick group: moves a repository's docs, decisions and test focus into an Uberblick corpus, with tags and a sidebar, after one review page.
ub-agents-deliver-report 1.9: the Changelog's issues and PRs show as GitHub pills, with the right issue or pull request icon.
ub-agents-deliver-report 1.8: the page's What to change cards open a Claude Code discussion too, and costs carry dates instead of "today".
ci-health 1.7: each action card's footer shows its evidence: where it applies, what it costs and the issues and PRs behind it, as GitHub pills.
ub-agents-deliver-report 1.7: a new delivery report document starts with its charts, without a KPI table.
ub-agents-deliver-report 1.6: a day runs midnight to midnight UTC on every machine, and the day is stored whenever an Uberblick server is connected.
ub-agents-deliver-report 1.5 and ci-health 1.6: a run fills in every day missing since the last one stored, not just yesterday.
The ub-agents-unblock page shows a short example run: the overview, one question with its recommendation, and what changed on GitHub.
ub-agents-deliver-report 1.4 and backlog-grooming 1.2: report pages declare UTF-8, so umlauts and dashes show correctly when the page is opened from disk.
ci-health 1.5: a chart of the share of runs on main that fail, re-runs included.
ci-health 1.4 and ub-agents-deliver-report 1.3: an action being applied is struck through on its card, with the pull request or issue below as a GitHub pill.
ub-agents-deliver-report 1.1 and ci-health 1.3: action cards with a Discuss in Claude Code button.
ci-health 1.2: the top three actions that would cut the wait, each with a link to discuss it in Claude Code, and line counts with scc or cloc that leave comments out.
Added ci-health 1.0 in the Maintenance group: CI wall time, jobs, tests and the changes that moved them.
Added backlog-grooming 1.1 in the new Maintenance group.
Added ub-agents-deliver-report, moved here from uberblick-2 and ub-agents.
One Claude Code plugin per skill group. The old /uberblick plugin is gone.
about: Uberblick builds ub-agents, the loop engineering framework for GitHub. The skills here come from running that loop on our own repositories, ub-agents included. The deliver report screenshots are one of its days.
